C0936.title: Vcredit FinTech Discloses an Illegal 'Agent Rights Protection' Black-Market Governance Case
C0936.summary: According to a December 2023 Vcredit FinTech disclosure, Xu collected several thousand yuan from a borrower, impersonated the borrower's relatives during collection calls, and used regulatory complaints about alleged abusive collection to pressure the company and demand compensation. Vcredit said it reported the clues to Shanghai Hongkou police, after which Xu was arrested in Jiangsu in August 2023. The disclosure shows how illegal agent complaints can use regulatory pressure and identity impersonation against financial institutions.
